name: calasign
description: Send PDFs for e-signature, track who signed and download signed documents with CalaSign.
long_description: CalaSign is a cloud e-signature service for Latin America. This extension connects Claude Desktop to your CalaSign account with an API key: list and inspect envelopes, check signing status, create envelopes from templates or PDFs, send them (always after your explicit confirmation), remind signers, void envelopes and download the sealed PDF. It is a thin local proxy to the CalaSign MCP server ({{BASE_URL}}/mcp), so tools stay in sync with the service.

tools.name: list_envelopes
tools.description: List envelopes (filter by status or text)

tools.name: get_envelope
tools.description: Envelope detail: documents, recipients and status

tools.name: get_signing_status
tools.description: Who signed, who is pending, last events

tools.name: create_envelope_from_template
tools.description: Create a draft envelope from a template

tools.name: send_envelope
tools.description: Send a draft (requires confirm=true after user approval)

tools.name: void_envelope
tools.description: Void an envelope in progress (requires confirm=true)

tools.name: download_signed_pdf
tools.description: Temporary link to the signed PDF

api_key.title: CalaSign API key
api_key.description: API key of your organization (Settings → API keys in CalaSign: {{BASE_URL}}/app/settings/api-keys).

base_url.title: CalaSign URL
base_url.description: Only change it for a custom domain or another environment.
